rows.en: (Oh yeah, Sheryl's concert is coming up soon.)
rows.notes: Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en: (I got so excited I've barely been sleeping...)
Haa... I can't wait for Sheryl's concert.
rows.notes: Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en: Huh...
rows.notes: ??? (woman) = Sheryl in disguise; also Michel in frd_rnk_005.

rows.en:
And I finally managed to get a ticket...
Tomorrow at school, I'm gonna brag about it
to Alto and the others!
I'm happy to hear you say that.
So what is it you like about my concerts?
rows.notes: Sheryl slips ('my') before the player notices. Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
The songs are great, of course,
but the live performance is the best!

If it were just the songs, there'd be no need
to come to a concert, after all.
rows.notes: Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
It's like the whole venue gets fired up together,
I guess... I can't really explain it well...
Wait...
Sheryl!!

...You seriously didn't notice?
Aren't you a little slow on the uptake?
S-sorry...
rows.notes: x5, player; also scd_fes_805.

rows.en:
Muttering to yourself like that isn't
a very good look, you know.
You heard that...?

If you'd been badmouthing me, you wouldn't have
gotten off easy, but it was a fair assessment,
so I'll forgive you.
That's a relief to hear...
So which song are you looking forward to?
Which song... Let me see.
Diamond Crevasse
rows.notes: Choice. Sheryl's song; wiki title 'Diamond Crevasse', not in glossary.

rows.en: Universal Bunny
rows.notes: Choice.

rows.en: Seikan Hikou
rows.notes: Choice. Glossary 'Seikan Hikou' (needs_check).

rows.en: It's gotta be "Diamond Crevasse."
Is that so?
Please, sing it for the encore!
I'll think about it.
It's gotta be "Universal Bunny."
So you've already checked out the new song too.

Of course!
It's gonna be the opening number, right!?
As if I'd tell you.
"Seikan Hikou," maybe? Kira☆
rows.notes: Ranka's song, offered to Sheryl as a joke (Sheryl answers with silence). Title per glossary (needs_check).

rows.en:
I-I'm just kidding...
But I'd love to hear a Sheryl version
of Seikan Hikou too!
rows.notes: Title per glossary (needs_check).

rows.en: Well, I'll think about it.
Well then, it's time for me to go.
Okay, good luck!
Yeah, yeah.
rows.notes: x56: Sheryl here; the player and others in many scenes. Generic.

rows.en: (Alright! I've gotta go home and study up!!)
rows.notes: Yoshuu: prepare (brush up on the songs) before the show.

rows.en: (I got so excited I've barely been sleeping...)
Haa... I can't wait for Sheryl's concert~!
rows.notes: No honorific in the Japanese here. Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
And I finally managed to get a ticket...
Tomorrow at school, I'm gonna brag about it
to everyone.

The songs are great, of course,
but the live performance is the best!

It's like the whole venue gets fired up together,
or something... I can't really explain it well...
Sheryl-san!!
I-I'm sorry...
Ahaha, you heard that...?

I-I'm just kidding...
But I'd love to hear your Seikan Hikou too,
Sheryl-san.
rows.notes: Title per glossary (needs_check).

rows.en:
(Sheryl called me up to the roof, but...
what does she want...? Ba-dump, ba-dump.)

I've been waiting for you,
\p!

Sheryl, what's up? Calling me out here
all of a sudden...
I got to hear your singing voice...
Huh? Wh-when did you hear it!?

The other day, when you were doing karaoke
all by yourself...

O-oh, I see...
So how was my singing?
...Ngh.
rows.notes: Kuh: Sheryl struggling for a kind word.

rows.en:
W-well... Let's just say it was...
you know...

It's so bad you can't even comment on it!?
W-was it really that awful??
I don't lie when it comes to music.
Th-that's harsh, Sheryl!
That's why I figured I'd teach you myself.

You should be weeping with joy, okay?
I hardly ever do favors like this, you know!?
I'm not going easy on you, got it?
No, no. Sing from your diaphragm.
rows.notes: Onaka kara: from the belly.

rows.en: Bohee-hogee-booooo
Open your mouth properly!
Hoo-hoo-hoo!
Th-that's getting a lot better.
Laa-laa-la-la-laa
Laa-laa-lagh-la-laa
rows.notes: The Japanese adds a voiced mark to one syllable (a cracked note).

rows.en: That's it, that's it! Keep that scale in mind!
Hah... hah...
Good work.
rows.notes: x4: Sheryl here; the player in ext_yui_004.

rows.en: Th-thanks...
rows.notes: x7: player, Pinon, Ranka.

rows.en: You've gotten much better.
R-really?

I'll have you show me the results sometime,
so be ready for it.
(I'll go practice some more at solo karaoke.)

(Sheryl-san called me up to the roof, but...
I wonder what she wants.)

I've been waiting for you,
\p-chan!

Sheryl-san, what's up? Calling me out here
all of a sudden...
